messages:
Victor (Support): heads up 61; support saw a customer hit a generic error when creating an embedding: `500 - Embedding service error (E1007)`. they see only 'Something went wrong' and no next steps. reporting request id: abc-123. can we tighten the copy?
Priya R.: agreed, 'Something went wrong' is too vague. we should give a friendly short line + an action. proposal: 'We couldn't create the embedding. Try again or contact support.' then under a smaller detail row show 'Error code: E1007' + a help link.
Alex D.: +1. tiny wording tweak to reduce cognitive load: primary line = 'We couldn't create your embedding.' secondary = 'Try again — if the problem continues, contact support.' primary CTA 'Try again' secondary 'Contact support' (link). keep the technical code collapsed behind 'Details'.
Jordan (A11y): accessibility considerations: put the error banner in an assertive live region so screen readers announce it. ensure focus moves to the banner after the failure so keyboard users don't miss it. the 'Details' disclosure should be keyboard-expandable and the content should not rely on color alone.
Sam L.: implementation note: we can surface the request id in the details and include a copy-to-clipboard button. avoid showing raw stack traces. also prefer passive language that doesn't blame the user.
Priya R.: tone nit: avoid 'failed' or 'error' in user-facing sentence. 'Couldn't create' is softer. also suggest the small helper copy under the CTA: 'We saved the request. No data was ingested.' helps reassure.
Alex D.: good idea. can we also add an ephemeral tooltip on hover for the support link: 'Include request id abc-123 in your ticket' so support gets faster triage. but don't show the id in the tooltip to avoid exposing on hover—only in details panel.
Victor (Support): the copy-to-clipboard for request id is huge for support. +1 to details panel. one ask: if rate-limited, can we detect and show 'Try again in 30s' so users don't spam retries?
Sam L.: we can detect rate-limit vs 500 and show a contextual message. for ETA we should be conservative: 'Try again in a minute' or show a specific Retry-After when available.
Jordan (A11y): one more: ensure buttons have clear accessible names: e.g., 'Try again (Retry embedding)' and 'Contact support (Open support form)'. avoid generic 'OK' for confirmations.
Priya R.: final suggested microcopy block: primary banner line: 'We couldn't create your embedding.' secondary helper: 'Try again — if the problem continues, contact support.' CTA primary: 'Try again' CTA secondary: 'Contact support' details toggle: 'Details' -> shows 'Error code: E1007', 'Request id: abc-123' + 'Copy' button. small note: 'No data was ingested.'
Alex D.: that's solid. @Sam L. can you add the copy variant to the PR that fixes the error banner + the details panel and include the aria/live behavior? we'll review in design sync. :thumbsup:
Sam L.: yep i'll open PR and include screenshots and the support copy snippet.
console-bot: design ticket created: "Embeddings create error microcopy + a11y" and assigned to @Sam L.
